summary:
Architectural implementation plan for the Classic Backup (Favourites JSON) feature.
- Resolves the MediaStore error by retargeting portable backup to 'Download/Pulse Player' using MediaStore.Downloads.
- Preserves the pulseplayer.favorites v1 JSON schema and fuzzy matching algorithm.
- Performs byte-for-byte audio file copies of all favorite tracks (including tracks imported via Full Backup).
- Supports deduplication (reusing existing files when size matches) and provides real-time progress callbacks and error telemetry.
- Delivers a one-tap auto-detect import from Download/Pulse Player alongside a SAF folder picker option.
- Stabilizes Gradle build configuration by aligning single-target debug build without flavor race conditions.
